 With 15 points and 5 rebounds, Walker Kessler is the leading scorer for the Los Angeles Lakers, while Okongwu leads the Atlanta Hawks offense with 12 points and 6 rebounds, a duel of centers on the court of the State Farm Arena.

 8:02 PM ET 26 minutes ago 2Q | 3:31: The Los Angeles Lakers have a 20-point lead
 The Los Angeles Lakers have a 20-point lead, and the home team is falling apart. Their defense has vanished, and there's no response from any player on the court. They've only managed 7 points off the bench, and they desperately need them.
 Live updates by Carlos Bernal
 7:59 PM ET 29 minutes ago 2Q | 5:08: Very little from either team on the court
 Very little from either team on the court. There have been few scoring opportunities in these early minutes, with both sides playing great defense to maintain this pace. Johnson and Doncic are leading their respective teams.
 Live updates by Carlos Bernal
 7:53 PM ET 36 minutes ago 2Q | 6:57: The Hawks are pressing hard to get back into the game
 The Hawks are pressing hard to get back into the game. Their second unit hasn't been very productive, and they've relied too heavily on the starters. The rotations need to start working to even things out.
 Live updates by Carlos Bernal
 7:49 PM ET 39 minutes ago 2Q | 12:00: The Lakers are still on a roll and force a timeout from their opponents
 The Lakers are still on a roll and force a timeout from their opponents. The visitors have a double-digit lead and have found their rhythm, putting them in control of the game. Luka Doncic has 9 points and 3 assists.
 Live updates by Carlos Bernal
 7:43 PM ET an hour ago 2Q | 12:00: We're back!
 We're back! The second quarter begins with the Los Angeles Lakers leading the Atlanta Hawks by 9 points. The best moments of the game are coming up, and we'll see more scoring opportunities as the home team looks to regain control.
 Live updates by Carlos Bernal
 7:36 PM ET an hour ago End of the first
 The first quarter ends.
 Live updates by Carlos Bernal
 7:33 PM ET an hour ago 1Q | 1:59: Everything evens out, Los Angeles reacts and with points from Luka Doncic
 Everything evens out, Los Angeles reacts and with points from Luka Doncic, everything is tied at 22 points and they also stop everything again to readjust and now steal the advantage before the end of the period on the court.
 Live updates by Carlos Bernal
 7:28 PM ET an hour ago 1Q | 3:06: The pace of the game has been a bit choppy
 The pace of the game has been a bit choppy, and neither team has been able to maintain control on the court. The basket seems to have temporarily closed, and the score remains unchanged. Austin Reaves is looking to take on a leadership role and bring the Lakers closer so things don't get even more complicated.
 Live updates by Carlos Bernal
 7:21 PM ET an hour ago 1Q | 6:36: Lakers timeout
 Lakers timeout. The home team is playing at a good pace and continues to surprise, now leading by 8 points and forcing their opponent to slow the game down. Jalen Johnson already has 5 points and is leading Atlanta's offense.
 Live updates by Carlos Bernal
 7:16 PM ET an hour ago 1Q | 9:12: A great start on the court, and both teams are going all
 A great start on the court, and both teams are going all out to score points. The home team quickly established a 5-point lead, and the Hawks are looking to end the Lakers' winning streak. Good minutes on the court.
 Live updates by Carlos Bernal
 6:59 PM ET an hour ago 1Q | 12:00: The NBA regular season game between the Atlanta Hawks
 The NBA regular season game between the Atlanta Hawks and the Los Angeles Lakers is underway at State Farm Arena. Follow all the action of this great matchup here on VAVEL. A great game awaits us tonight.
 Live updates by Carlos Bernal
 6:56 PM ET 2 hours ago Close to start
 We are just minutes away from the start of the game presentation, the players' entrance, and the NBA's pre-game protocols for this Playoffs game between the Los Angeles Lakers and Atlanta Hawks at State Farm Arena.
 Live updates by Carlos Bernal
 6:48 PM ET 2 hours ago The season goes on!
 The NBA championship continues, and the regular season is in full swing as teams look to fine-tune their chemistry to achieve their goals. This time, we have a matchup between the Los Angeles Lakers and the Atlanta Hawks, two teams that have recently undergone a period of transformation and now aspire to be title contenders in the postseason.

 6:37 PM ET 2 hours ago The Preview!
 Today we have a very interesting game between the Atlanta Hawks and the Los Angeles Lakers, with both teams looking for a win to continue the 2026 NBA Regular Season in a good way and ensure a high level of play.
 Live updates by Carlos Bernal
 6:29 PM ET 2 hours ago Here we go!
 We're just under an hour away from the game between the Atlanta Hawks and the Los Angeles Lakers at State Farm Arena. Both teams will be looking for the win. Who will come out on top this time? Follow our coverage on VAVEL.
 Live updates by Carlos Bernal
 6:29 PM ET 2 hours ago Luka Doncic, the star of the Los Angeles Lakers!
 Luka Doncic is the player to watch for the Los Angeles Lakers. The league's leading scorer last season, he enters this game as the team's primary scorer and will look to add to his scoring alongside Walker Kessler. Undoubtedly, the connection between the point guard and Austin Reaves is paying off for a team under intense scrutiny and hoping to return to the conference finals. Live updates by Carlos Bernal
 5:58 PM ET 3 hours ago Atlanta Hawks Absences!
 These are the players on the team's injured list: None. Despite not having any seriously injured players, the Atlanta team has some doubts about the availability of certain players, who will be announced for the game at the last minute.
 Live updates by Carlos Bernal
 5:13 PM ET 3 hours ago Jalen Johnson, the Atlanta Hawks player to watch!
 The Atlanta Hawks' star point guard, Jalen, finished last season as the team's leading scorer and is starting a new season with less pressure due to his inexperience, aiming to lead the team to another playoff appearance. Jalen will look to take advantage of the Hawks' revamped roster and complement CJ McCollum's game to help Atlanta return to NBA championship contention. Live updates by Carlos Bernal
 4:25 PM ET 4 hours ago Los Angeles Lakers Absences!
 These are the players currently on the team's injured list: None. Despite having players with non-critical injuries, the Los Angeles team has several players available to cover these absences. Further roster changes will be announced at the last minute.

 4:00 PM ET 4 hours ago Where is the game?
 State Farm Arena in Atlanta will host this regular season game between two teams looking to continue their preparations for the 2026-2027 NBA season in their respective conferences. The arena has a capacity of 16,800 fans and was inaugurated in 1999.
 Live updates by Carlos Bernal
 4:00 PM ET 4 hours ago Los Angeles Lakers, ready to fight for the title!
 The Lakers arrive in Atlanta with a record of 9 wins and 2 losses in first place in the Western Conference and looking to stay there in this first part of the regular season, among their ranks we find great players like Austin Reaves, Luka Doncic and Walker Kessler. Live updates by Carlos Bernal

 Welcome to the live broadcast of the Los Angeles Lakers vs Atlanta Hawks game, part of the 2026-2027 NBA Regular Season. The game will take place at State Farm Arena.
